## Expected and observed behavior

Describe what went wrong, especially any mathematical meaning the view changed
or implied without justification.

## Minimal reproduction

Include a small Lean statement or trusted project definition, input mode
(browser or editor), and steps. Remove private work, credentials, and local
machine paths. A screenshot can supplement the source but should not replace it.

## Environment

Include the commit/version, OS, Node and Lean versions, and relevant diagnostics.
